verdict.rationale: Sierra's Ghostwriter lets users build or modify agents by describing the desired behavior, updating workflows, integrations, guardrails, tone and style with simple prompts. Agent Studio and Ghostwriter can also generate customer journeys from SOPs or transcripts, and Explorer answers natural-language questions across real conversations. A community account adds light corroboration that agents are set up by describing how they should work, but the evidence is mostly vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Ghostwriter/Explorer natural-language control, and evidence that operational tasks like publishing, release approval and traffic splitting can be driven by natural-language commands rather than UI or CI/CD.
